errors.message: Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint:

name: set_image_from_base64
description: Sets an inventory item's photo or the company logo from a small image sent inline as base64. Use this for a photo the user pasted into the chat when you can run code on the file but your sandbox can't reach this server (otherwise prefer get_image_upload_link, which keeps the full-size photo). Shrink

name: get_image_upload_link
description: Creates a one-time upload link for an inventory item's photo or the company logo, valid for 15 minutes and for one upload. Best for full-size photos. Two ways to use it: (1) if you can run code and your sandbox can reach this server, POST the image file to the link as multipart/form-data with the fi

name: list_custom_fields
description: Lists the reusable custom field definitions for the user's company. Custom fields hold extra per-item details such as lot number, expiry date, serial number, color or bin location. Call this before setting a field so you reuse an existing field name instead of creating a near-duplicate.

name: get_inventory_item_custom_fields
description: Gets the custom field values set on a given inventory item by its id. Returns each field's name, value, and whether it is shown as a column in the inventory table.

name: set_inventory_item_custom_field
description: Sets (creates or updates) a custom field value on an inventory item. Provide the inventory item id, the field name (an existing field with that name is reused, otherwise a new field is created for the company), and the value. showInTable is a per-field, company-wide setting: true shows the field as

name: set_inventory_item_custom_field_by_name
description: Sets (creates or updates) a custom field on an inventory item referenced by its name instead of its id, so you can act on a request like "set the roast level for regular beans to Dark" in one step. Provide the item name (matched within the user's company), the field name (an existing field with that

name: remove_inventory_item_custom_field
description: Removes a custom field value from an inventory item by item id and field name. The reusable field definition itself is left in place for other items. Returns true if a value was removed.

name: get_inventory
description: Gets all items in inventory that belong to the users company. Inventory items have a name, id, value (cost), stock, and other parameters. Quantities are decimals. When an item has a unit (e.g. "kg", "lb", "ml") every quantity on it (inventoryCount, onOrderCount, damagedCount, toShipCount) is measure

name: find_item_by_barcode
description: Find an inventory item by its barcode (UPC, EAN, or Code 128 / SKU value) within the user's company. Returns the matching item or an error if none matches.

name: edit_inventory_item
description: Edit an existing inventory item. If field is not to be changed then leave null. Id field is required. Counts are absolute new values in the item unit of measure (decimals allowed, e.g. 2.5 for 2.5 kg). Set unit to change the unit label (e.g. "kg"); it does not convert existing quantities.

name: edit_inventory_item_name
description: Edit the name of an existing inventory item by Id

name: delete_inventory_item
description: Delete a given inventory item by Id. Returns true if success.

name: create_new_inventory_item
description: Create a new inventory item by name, and return the object with the id of the new inventory item. Pass an optional unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "lb", "g", "ml", "L") for items tracked by weight or volume; leave it null for items counted in pieces.

name: list_deleted_inventory_items
description: Lists the inventory items that were deleted in the user's company, newest first, with when and by whom. Deleted items keep their history and can be brought back with restore_inventory_item.

name: restore_inventory_item
description: Restores a deleted inventory item by Id (see list_deleted_inventory_items), with its counts, units, custom field values and history. Order lines and assembly parts removed by the delete are not restored. Returns the restored item.

name: list_unit_custom_fields
description: Lists custom field values on a stock line (inventory unit) by unit id. Use for lot number, expiry, and other per-line attributes.

name: set_unit_custom_field
description: Sets (creates or updates) a custom field on a stock line by unit id. Field names are reused company-wide; new names are created with Unit scope. showInTable shows the field as a column on unit lists. Returns the saved field.

name: find_units_by_custom_field
description: Finds stock lines across the company where a unit custom field matches a value (case-insensitive contains). Use for lot recalls: fieldName "Lot #" and value "abc123". Returns item name, unit id, quantity, status, and the field value.

name: list_inventory_units
description: Lists the stock lines of an inventory item by its id. Each line has a name, optional identifier (serial), quantity, status (InStock, Ordered, Outbound, Damaged), and may hold unit custom fields such as lot number. Item totals are the sum of line quantities by status.

name: add_inventory_unit
description: Adds a stock line to an inventory item. Provide inventory item id, name, optional identifier (serial, lot code, or other label), quantity (default 1), and status (InStock, Ordered, Outbound, Damaged). Use quantity greater than 1 for fungible groups (e.g. 5 of the same lot). An item can track at most

name: set_inventory_unit_status
description: Sets the status of an entire stock line by unit id (moves the full quantity). Status accepts InStock, Ordered, Outbound or Damaged. For moving only part of a line's quantity, use move_inventory_unit_quantity instead. Returns the updated line.

name: move_inventory_unit_quantity
description: Moves a quantity from a stock line to another status. If quantity is less than the line's quantity, the line is split (lot/custom fields are copied onto the new line). Use this for partial ship/receive of a lot line. Status accepts InStock, Ordered, Outbound or Damaged. Returns the line that holds t

name: set_inventory_unit_identifier
description: Sets (or changes) the identifier of a stock line by its unit id. The identifier is a free-form label: serial number, asset tag, lot code, or similar. Pass an empty value to clear it. Does not change quantity. Returns the updated unit.

name: remove_inventory_unit
description: Removes a stock line by its unit id. The parent item's stock totals are recomputed from remaining lines. Returns true if a line was removed.

name: create_order
description: Create a new order for the company. Use Type "Inbound" to restock items from a supplier (the default) or "Outbound" to ship items out. Supply a name and the line items to order (each line is an inventory item plus a count). Identify each line's item by inventoryItemId (from get_inventory) or by item

name: take_inventory_snapshot
description: Take a reconciliation snapshot of the company's current inventory. This captures the current count, on-order, damaged, in-use, and value of every inventory item at this moment in time so it can be reviewed or compared later. Provide a name (for example a date or audit label) and optional notes.

name: get_reorder_suggestions
description: List inventory items that are at or below their reorder point, with the suggested quantity to order (in the item unit of measure when it has one) and the preferred supplier.

name: generate_purchase_orders
description: Create draft inbound purchase orders for every item at or below its reorder point, grouped by preferred supplier. Returns how many orders and lines were created. The orders are drafts; complete them in the app when the stock arrives.

name: list_suppliers
description: List the company's suppliers (id, name, email, phone, lead time in days).

name: create_supplier
description: Create a supplier for the company by name (other contact details optional). Returns the new supplier id.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: set_image_from_base64, get_image_upload_link, list_suppliers · Private data: set_image_from_base64, get_image_upload_link, create_supplier · Public sink: get_image_upload_link, list_suppliers · Destructive: set_image_from_base64, get_image_upload_link, remove_inventory_item_custom_field, delete_inventory_item, restore_inventory_item, remove_inventory_unit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: set_image_from_base64, get_image_upload_link, list_suppliers · Private data: set_image_from_base64, get_image_upload_link, create_supplier · Public sink: get_image_upload_link, list_suppliers · Destructive: set_image_from_base64, get_image_upload_link, remove_inventory_item_custom_field, delete_inventory_item, restore_inventory_item, remove_inventory_unit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
